title: CGU ALICE alert leads to a cut of about R$100 million in the reference value of a federal road-works tender (reported 30 December 2024)
summary: A CGU ALICE alert on a federal road-works tender led managers to cut its reference value by about R$100 million, per CGU's 30 December 2024 results release
account: In its 30 December 2024 statement on the year's results, the Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) reported that an alert from its ALICE robot led CGU auditors to examine the budget of a federal road-works engineering tender, after which federal managers made adjustments that reduced the reference value by about R$100 million (CGU audit report 1632530). The statement names neither the contracting agency nor the date of the case, and its 'this year' framing attaches only to a separate water-bottle example, so the date observed is the date of the release that reports it. The same release gives 2024 aggregates: 118,069 procurement processes analyzed, 206 preventive audits opened on purchases worth R$25.57 billion, and R$257.25 million saved in concluded audits. ALICE reads planning documents and notices on Compras.gov.br with artificial-intelligence techniques and issues risk alerts that auditors confirm.
purpose: Continuous automated audit of federal procurement to flag budget and pricing risks before contracting
system: ALICE (Analisador de Licitações, Contratos e Editais), CGU text-mining and AI alert tool
domain: Public administration: government audit and procurement control
taxonomy_note: Closest fit; the benefit is a corrected public-works budget. Filed as a protective response rather than a benefit created: the CGU frames ALICE's alerts as meant to prevent unnecessary spending ('evitar que gastos desnecessários ou em desconformidade aconteçam'), and the sources do not show that the overestimated reference value would otherwise have been paid. The sources give no date for the road-works case; the date observed is the date of the CGU release that reports it.

ratings.reason: Material to the federal budget: about R$100 million removed from a single tender's reference value, per the CGU.
Small at national scale and the contracting agency is not named, limiting traceability.

ai_role.statement: The CGU states the chain explicitly: 'A partir do alerta do ALICE, auditores da CGU examinaram a adequação de um orçamento de uma obra rodoviária, o que gerou ajustes efetuados pelos gestores federais.' The adjustment was made by managers after a human audit; ALICE's role was the initial alert. Developer and deployer are the same public body; the page was retrieved from the Internet Archive because the live gov.br page was restricted during Brazil's 2026 electoral period.
